known_constraints: parents do not know full details of the breakup

constraints: Cannot afford therapy twice a week
priorities: Protect my dignity when interacting with my ex

past_decisions.situation_summary: Ex asked to keep a shared necklace after the breakup; Maya felt pressured to agree.
past_decisions.chosen_option: Returned the necklace and asked for no further contact for one month.
past_decisions.outcome: Felt clearer boundaries but still anxious about running into him on campus.

past_decisions.situation_summary: Ex offered 3000 RMB as a 'closure gift' after cheating was revealed.
past_decisions.chosen_option: Declined the money and blocked payment requests.
past_decisions.outcome: Avoided feeling bought off; short-term stress from mutual friends gossip.

past_decisions.situation_summary: Roommate suggested partying to forget the breakup versus resting.
past_decisions.chosen_option: Skipped the party and scheduled a counseling intake.
past_decisions.outcome: Sleep improved; still processing anger in waves.
